target_customer: Multi-unit restaurant groups, cafes and bars in the US and Canada
problem: Restaurant back of house runs on disconnected tools, spreadsheets and clipboards, causing stockouts, waste and lost profit. Marble replaces the stack with one AI system for inventory, ordering, scheduling and finance.
product_category: AI restaurant back of house operating system

prior_employers: Goldman Sachs (investment banking analyst, restaurants and food and beverage)
education: University of Michigan, Ross School of Business, minor in Computer Science
founders.background_notes: Grew up managing his family's multi-unit restaurant business per the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Computer vision inventory counts, item level demand forecasting and agent workflows across POS, labor and accounting integrations are standard applied AI with hard integration work, built by two people.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations into POS and accounting create some lock-in, but funded incumbents shipped AI features in 2026 and the product can be copied.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents announced AI features in April and May 2026, around the time of the batch.

market_need_then: The company says restaurants lose billions a year to stockouts, food waste and lost profit. One founder grew up in a family restaurant business and the company shows an A&W case study, which is a company claim.

branding.domain_note: Uses joinmarble.ai, with founders' email on joinmarble.com. Earlier address usetruffle.ai now redirects.

identity.logo: wordmark in ink and white versions
identity.voice_and_tone: short declarative headlines such as Go live in weeks, not quarters

brand_strength.rationale: Launch coverage exists but no brand focused press. Many unrelated companies share the name Marble, including a tax AI company that raised 9M dollars.

outcome_analysis: Marble is a Summer 2026 company with a three person team and no exit. The founders pair restaurant operating experience with applied AI engineering, and the site names several restaurant customers. The main risk is that established restaurant software vendors added AI features in spring 2026, so winning depends on speed and integration depth.
notes: Dealroom lists a 125k dollar seed and a YC linked profile says about 130k dollars, with no named investors, so it is unverified and not recorded as a round. Other companies called Marble raised larger rounds and are unrelated. The rename from Truffle to Marble in mid 2026 comes mainly from one source, yespress, and the YC page does not mention it. The site customer logos and metrics are company claims. YC page says team of 3, other sources say 2. Completeness pass: Round rests on a single database (Dealroom): a 125k dollar seed with no date or investors; a YC linked profile says about 130k dollars. Not cross-checked by press; searches found no press tying any other Marble round to this company.
